svg.aria-label: The plane of radius divided by the sonic radius against flow speed divided by the sound speed, for steady spherical isothermal flow. Two curves cross at the critical point at coordinates one, one: the accelerating wind and the accretion solution. Below them lie the breeze solutions, which stay subsonic and decay; above them the solutions that are supersonic everywhere; and to the sides two double-valued families that turn back before reaching the sonic radius and so cannot connect the base to infinity.
